mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND document_id = #{id} ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE file_object f SET expires_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE f.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND f.purpose = 'knowledge' AND f.id = #{file} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.enterprise_id = f.enterprise_id AND (d.file_id = f.id OR d.active_file_id = f.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.enterprise_id = f.enterprise_id AND c.file_id = f.id)
